eyebrow: Step two — add the success-after check
code:
let Failures = SigninLogs
  | where ResultType != "0"
  | summarize FailedCount = count(),
      LastFailure = max(TimeGenerated)
      by UserPrincipalName, bin(TimeGenerated, 10m)
  | where FailedCount > 5;
let Successes = SigninLogs
  | where ResultType == "0"
  | project SuccessTime = TimeGenerated,
      UserPrincipalName, IPAddress;
Failures
| join kind=inner Successes on UserPrincipalName
| where SuccessTime > LastFailure
    and SuccessTime < LastFailure + 10m
caption: The join plus the SuccessTime check is the "after the failures" rule, now enforced in KQL.
